name: Malama Seafront C
pinSource: Matched the developer's own phase-C plot aerial (karmadevelopers.com image 'Malama-Seafront-Phase-C-plot', plot outlined and labelled 'Phase C' next to outlined 'Phase A'/'Phase B') and the presentation aerial 'Project Location' (labels Malama A, B, C) against Esri World Imagery: the C plot is the field/brush strip on the east side of the Kapparis headland, between the coastal footpath and the fields, just north of the modern white villa complex and roughly 250-300 m south-east of the completed phase-A villas. Pin = centre of that strip. Medium confidence, about +/-60 m; not a surveyed plot centroid. NOTE: the Google Maps place marker embedded on the developer's Malama page (35.054066, 34.018480) sits on the phase-A villas, not on phase C, so it was not used.
amenities: Lower level (67 m²) in addition to the main floors
Seafront plot along the coastal footpath
facts: Malama Seafront C is an off-plan phase of detached seafront villas in Kapparis, Protaras area, Famagusta district; it follows phase A, whose four villas are completed and sold.

The phase-C plot is on the coast along the coastal footpath on the Kapparis headland, a few hundred metres south-east of the completed phase-A villas, with phase B lying between them (developer aerials).
The villa on the price list (C04, plan type A) has 4 bedrooms, 4 bathrooms plus a guest WC, 225.9 m² internal area, a 67 m² lower level and 358 m² total buildable area.
Outdoor space for that villa: 27.6 m² covered verandas, 9.5 m² uncovered verandas, a 28 m² roof garden, covered parking and a private infinity pool on a 653 m² plot.
The developer's phase-C description says the villas have five bathrooms/WCs, contemporary kitchens and layouts planned to give sea views from several levels.
The developer's renders of phase C show flat-roofed contemporary villas finished in natural stone, timber cladding and render, with large glazed openings and infinity pools facing the sea.
The developer's aerial that labels Malama A, B and C gives about 400 m to Ayia Triada beach, 1 km to Vrysoudi Beach, 2 km to Paralimni Marina and 5 km to Protaras centre.
The developer's project page gives energy rating A for Malama Seafront (project-wide; no phase-C EPC document was supplied).
The developer's availability table lists four villas in phase C, of which only villa 4 is shown as available.

conflicts: GALLERY: the SharePoint share has no phase-C folder. Phase C is a DIFFERENT design from phase A: phase A = four large detached mansions (420-448 m² buildable, 939-1,116 m² plots, vertical concrete fins), while the developer's phase-C renders show smaller flat-roofed villas with stone and timber cladding on 473-700 m² plots (240-360 m² buildable). The gallery is therefore limited to 5 real drone photos of the Kapparis coastline/setting taken from the phase-A site; the completed and under-construction phase-A villas are visible in them. None of the images shows C04 or the phase-C plot itself.

Bathrooms: price list says 4 full baths & WC; developer website availability table says '5 Bath + WC' for every phase-C villa; the website's phase-C text says 'five bathrooms/WCs' (which matches 4 baths + 1 WC).

Villa 4 / C04: website availability table lists villa 4 as 6 bedrooms, 263 m² buildable, 653 m² plot; price list C04 = 4 bedrooms, 358 m² total buildable, 653 m² plot. Plot agrees; bedrooms and area do not (the website's villa-1 row, 4 bed / 360 m², resembles C04). Price list wins.

Number of villas in phase C: website text says phase C 'includes Villas 4, 5, and 6' (three villas); the website availability table lists four villas (1-4); the renders show four villas in two pairs. totalUnitsInScheme left null.

Distances: the website (project-wide text) says Malama Seafront is 200 m from Malama beach; the presentation gives 350 m for phase A, and phase C lies further south-east than phase A, so 200 m to Malama beach is unlikely to hold for C. Airport: website 55 km vs presentation 45 km (Larnaca). Content uses only the distances on the aerial that labels Malama C (Ayia Triada 400 m, Paralimni Marina 2 km, Protaras centre 5 km).
Website 'Details' box (units 8, 4-5 bedrooms, 420.66-448.51 m², plots 939-1,116 m²) describes phase A, not C.
Website Google Maps marker (35.054066, 34.018480) marks the phase-A site, not phase C.
